title: Output pivotal probability under constant bias
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $p\in(0,1)$, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, choose an output sign $b\in\{\pm1\}$, and choose a coordinate $i$. When every coordinate has bias $p$, the probability that $f$ outputs $b$ and changing coordinate $i$ changes the output, under the heterogeneous product distribution, equals the corresponding probability under the product distribution with common bias $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube to signs
The specified output $b$ is a sign
